/core/builtins/calculations-expressions/.title: ABS
/core/builtins/calculations-expressions/.description: Returns the absolute value of a number.

/core/builtins/calculations-expressions/.title: AND
/core/builtins/calculations-expressions/.description: Returns true when all arguments are truthy.

/core/builtins/calculations-expressions/.title: ARRAY
/core/builtins/calculations-expressions/.description: Builds an array from arguments or parses a string.

/core/builtins/calculations-expressions/.title: CEILING
/core/builtins/calculations-expressions/.description: Rounds a value up to the nearest multiple of a factor.

/core/builtins/calculations-expressions/.title: CHOICELABEL
/core/builtins/calculations-expressions/.description: Returns the selected label from a single-choice field.

/core/builtins/calculations-expressions/.title: CHOICELABELS
/core/builtins/calculations-expressions/.description: Returns an array of selected labels from a multi-choice field.

/core/builtins/calculations-expressions/.title: CHOICEVALUE
/core/builtins/calculations-expressions/.description: Returns the selected value from a single-choice field.

/core/builtins/calculations-expressions/.title: CHOICEVALUES
/core/builtins/calculations-expressions/.description: Returns an array of selected values from a multi-choice field.

/core/builtins/calculations-expressions/.title: COS
/core/builtins/calculations-expressions/.description: Returns the cosine of a value (in radians).

/core/builtins/calculations-expressions/.title: COUNT
/core/builtins/calculations-expressions/.description: Counts numeric values in an array.

/core/builtins/calculations-expressions/.title: COUNTA
/core/builtins/calculations-expressions/.description: Counts all items in an array.

/core/builtins/calculations-expressions/.title: COUNTBLANK
/core/builtins/calculations-expressions/.description: Counts blank values in an array (null, undefined, empty string).

/core/builtins/calculations-expressions/.title: DATANAMES
/core/builtins/calculations-expressions/.description: Returns field data names, optionally filtered by type.

/core/builtins/calculations-expressions/.title: EVAL
/core/builtins/calculations-expressions/.description: Evaluates a dynamic expression in a restricted context.

/core/builtins/calculations-expressions/.title: FORM
/core/builtins/calculations-expressions/.description: Accesses the form schema (planned, not yet implemented).

/core/builtins/calculations-expressions/.title: HASOTHER
/core/builtins/calculations-expressions/.description: Returns true if an “other” value was entered.

/core/builtins/calculations-expressions/.title: IF
/core/builtins/calculations-expressions/.description: Choose between two values based on a condition.

/core/builtins/calculations-expressions/.title: OR
/core/builtins/calculations-expressions/.description: Returns true when any argument is truthy.

/core/builtins/calculations-expressions/.title: OTHER
/core/builtins/calculations-expressions/.description: Returns the “other” label when present.

/core/builtins/calculations-expressions/.title: ROUND
/core/builtins/calculations-expressions/.description: Rounds a number to a given number of decimal places.

/core/builtins/calculations-expressions/.title: SETRESULT
/core/builtins/calculations-expressions/.description: Sets the result value for multi-line expressions.

/core/builtins/calculations-expressions/.title: SIN
/core/builtins/calculations-expressions/.description: Returns the sine of a value (in radians).

/core/builtins/calculations-expressions/.title: UPPER
/core/builtins/calculations-expressions/.description: Converts a value to an uppercase string.
